title: SHS Bihar Recruitment 2026 – Specialist Doctors (Obstetrician & Gynaecologist, Paediatrician, Anaesthetist, Physician/MD Medicine, General Surgeon, Orthopaedic Surgeon) Posts

howToApply: Visit the official website of State Health Society, Bihar: https://shs.bihar.gov.in/
Navigate to the ‘HUMAN RESOURCE’ section and click on ‘Advertisement’ page.
Read the advertisement, guidelines, TOR, and other instructions carefully before applying.
Click on the online application link provided on the advertisement page.
Fill in all required details carefully and accurately in the online application form.

Upload a recent passport-size colour photograph (taken within 3 months, white background, clear face with open eyes, no dark glasses or cap) in jpg/jpeg/png format and signature in jpg/jpeg/png format.
Mention all certificate/mark sheet numbers and issue dates in the designated columns.
Select up to 3 preferred districts for posting in the online application.
Submit the online application form before the last date (21/08/2026 by 06:00 PM).
Download and print a copy of the submitted application form and keep it safe until the recruitment process is complete.
Print 5 copies of the passport-size photograph uploaded in the online application and keep them safe.
Do not submit multiple applications; duplicate applications may lead to cancellation of candidature.

shortInfo: SJVN has announced notification for Chief General Manager, Deputy Manager, Engineer posts. Required qualification: B.E/B.Tech, M.Sc. Last date to apply: 26-08-26.

dates.event: Last Date for Receipt of Application Print Out at SJVN Office

howToApply: Visit SJVN official website www.sjvn.nic.in and register in the Career section.
Ensure you have a valid Email ID and Mobile number before registering.
Fill up all details in the online application form carefully, including qualification and experience details.
Upload recent passport size color photograph (max 50 KB, .jpg) and signature in Blue/Black Ink (max 50 KB, .jpg).

Send the printout along with Payment Receipt, Experience details (clearly stating pay scale & relevant experience), and certificates in support of Educational/Professional Qualification, Age, Category, Experience, etc. to: O/o DGM (HR/Recruitment), SJVN Limited, Shakti Sadan, Corporate Head Quarters, Shanan Shimla, HP-171006 by 15/09/2026.

title: Patna High Court Recruitment 2026 – Ex-Cadre Assistant Posts
shortInfo: Patna High Court has announced notification for Ex-Cadre Assistant posts. Required qualification: Graduate, Diploma in Computer Application. Last date to apply: 27-08-26.

dates.event: Last Date for Online Application Submission
Last Date for Online Fee Payment

howToApply: Visit the official website of Patna High Court at https://patnahighcourt.gov.in.
Click on the ‘Recruitments’ tab in the left-hand menu column.
Click on the link ‘Ex-Cadre Assistant Recruitment Examination, 2026’.
Click on ‘Apply Online’ and then click on ‘New Registration’.
Fill in your Full Name, Father’s Name, Mother’s Name, Gender, Reservation Category, Date of Birth, Mobile Number, Email ID etc. and submit the registration form.
Note the Registration Number and Password sent via SMS/Email and login.
Fill in Personal Details and click ‘Submit’, then fill in Education Details and click ‘Submit’.
Capture your live photograph as per the instructions provided.

Upload all required documents: Scanned signature, Matriculation Certificate & Marksheet, Graduation Certificate & Marksheet, Computer Diploma/Certificate, NOC (if applicable), Identity Proof, Domicile Certificate (if applicable), Caste/NCL/EWS Certificate (if applicable), Disability Certificate (if applicable), and other relevant documents.
Preview the application form on the Print Preview Page, verify all details, check the checkbox, and proceed to payment.
Pay the application fee online (link active from 28.07.2026 to 27.08.2026, and again on 29.08.2026 and 30.08.2026).
After payment, the application form is finally submitted. No changes are allowed after payment.
Take a printout of the finally submitted online application form with payment details and retain it for future reference.

vacancyList.postName: Act Apprentice – New Bongaigaon Workshop (NBQS) & Engineering Workshop (EWS/BNGN)

howToApply: Visit the official NFR website: www.nfr.indianrailways.gov.in
Navigate to: General Info → Departments → Personnel → Act Apprentice Notification
Register yourself and then log in to the portal.
Fill in the ONLINE application form carefully, indicating Units of choice in order of preference.

Upload all mandatory documents: Mark sheet & Pass Certificate of Matriculation (Class X), ITI Provisional Certificate/NTC issued by NCVT/SCVT, Final ITI mark sheet, and other applicable certificates (caste, disability, EWS, etc.).

title: BPSSC Recruitment 2026 – Forest Range Officer Posts
shortInfo: BPSSC has announced notification for Forest Range Officer posts. Required qualification: Bachelor's degree in relevant fields. Last date to apply: 16-08-26.

vacancyList.postName: Forest Range Officer (Vanon ke Kshetra Adhikari)

howToApply: Visit the official website: https://bpssc.bihar.gov.in and go to the ‘Forest Dept.’ tab.
Click on the link related to Advt. No. 10/2026.
Register with a valid mobile number and email ID. Registration ID and Password will be sent via SMS/email.
Complete Part 1 of the online application (registration details: name, nationality, mobile, email, domicile, reservation category, gender, date of birth) and make the payment online.
Login with the Registration ID and Password to fill Part 2 of the application (father/husband name, mother’s name, address, educational qualification, etc.).
Upload a recent colour photograph (white background, 15-25 KB, .jpg/.jpeg/.gif) and signature in English and Hindi (black or blue ink, white background, 15-25 KB, .jpg/.jpeg/.gif).
Review all details carefully, then click ‘Confirm’ and ‘Submit’ the application.
After submission, a confirmation message will be sent to the registered mobile/email. Print the Acknowledgement on A4 size paper and keep it safe for future reference.
Application fee must be paid online (Net Banking / Credit Card / Rupay Debit Card). Fee once paid is non-refundable.
Only one online application per candidate is allowed. Multiple applications will be rejected.
